start_here: Say to your AI: "Check that the source files my last commit deleted from my trillion checkout say where they went: range HEAD~1..HEAD." It runs tool:check-deleted-code-names-its-home on the folder you grant and tells you, per deleted file, its new home or why it was retired.
no_lists_because: It reads commits and moved-from.json receipts in your checkouts and keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Grant the checkout to read (a repository named trillion, trillion-rust, trillion-workshop or trillion-apps); put the other checkouts in folders of those names beside it so their receipts can be read.
2. Say "Check what my last commit deleted" and give range as <from>..<to>, for example HEAD~1..HEAD (add repository when the folder is named otherwise).

3. Read what comes back: valid is true when every deleted source or test file has a moved-from.json receipt or a retirement row with a decision; errors names each file that has neither; unread names any repository with no checkout beside yours.
4. For each error, move the file with a moved-from.json receipt in its new home, or add a row to retired-paths.json whose decision holds by, words and source; then run the check again.

worked_examples.title: A deleted file whose receipt sits in the workshop checkout
worked_examples.ask: Check that the file my last commit deleted from trillion says where it went.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/check-deleted-code-names-its-home/do-work/check-deleted-code-names-its-home.mjs and test/check-row.test.mjs (the Trillion-X/trillion receipt case). The granted checkout /work/trillion has one commit that deleted src/a.mjs. Beside it, /work/trillion-workshop holds tools/x/moved-from.json = {"source":"Trillion-X/trillion","files":[{"from":"src/a.mjs","to":"tools/x/src/a.mjs"}]}. There is no checkout beside it for trillion-rust or trillion-apps.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result":{"valid":true,"judged":[{"path":"src/a.mjs","home":{"repository":"trillion-workshop","path":"tools/x/src/a.mjs","receipt":"tools/x/moved-from.json"},"how":"moved-from receipt"}],"errors":[],"unread":["trillion-rust: no checkout at /work/trillion-rust","trillion-apps: no checkout at /work/trillion-apps"]}}
